text:
Mara K: Quick proposal  Action Journal pilot for postmortem follow-ups. One canonical item per incident: owner, due date, status, recurrence flag, postmortem link, and IC-rotation note. 8-week pilot, weekly 15-min pulse. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jordan L: Yes. Can we auto-create from the postmortem close step so it's near-zero friction?

Samir: I can draft a minimal template. Prefer GH issues so we get assignees and reminders. Template: - Incident ID, - PM link, - Owner @, - Due YYYY-MM-DD, - Priority, - Status, - Recurrence: none/recurring/suspected, - 1-line RCA, - Tasks.

Khalid: +1 GH issues. Add label "recurring-pattern" and a small dashboard for heatmap of routes.

Rowan: For IC rotation, add a flag in the journal: keep/rotate. Put a monthly IC calendar in the handbook. Helps spread knowledge.

Elena: Comms cadence suggestion: T+0 post in #incidents and triage in #eng-oncall, T+1h update, T+24h summary + action journal link, T+72h remediation update, weekly pulse until closed. Make the T+24h include owners/due dates/recurrence for product/support visibility.

Mara K: Good. Volunteers?

Jordan L: I'll create the repo and GH Actions to auto-open issues and add a ping 48h before due.

Samir: I'll own the template and the pulse checklist doc.

Khalid: I'll build the recurring-pattern dashboard and labels.

Rowan: I'll own the IC rotation calendar and handbook entry.

ops-bot: reminder: Action Journal template posted (https://go.redwood.example/action-journal-template) :bell:

Mara K: Aim to start next Monday. Acceptance criteria: owners assigned within 48h, >80% actions have due dates, weekly pulse scheduled. If no objections, I'll kick off tomorrow.

Jordan L: Sounds good.

Samir: Good to go.

Khalid: :thumbsup:

Elena: :+1:

Mara K: Thanks everyone  I'll post kickoff + link tomorrow. Ping me if you want in on the pilot.
